verdict.headline: Cantinho da Baia Mid-morning — 11:00
verdict.reason: Cantinho da Baia is worth a quick check for mid-morning — 11:00, but it is not a guaranteed session.  Treat it as a check-first call rather than a sure thing.  The wind should be manageable, but not a big advantage.  The tide is a bit awkward for the bay, so stay cautious.

conversationalSummary.text: TODAY I’d do a quick Surfline and MEO Beachcam check first, and only head out if Cantinho da Baia looks properly in. In the mid-morning window around 11:00 the spot should be the best bet, but at dead low it can be basically flat or too weak in the sheltered bay, so don’t rely on it unless the cams show more push. Wind is mixed and cross-on, so it may be workable rather than big. If the cameras don’t look noticeably better than expected, it’s probably not worth chasing.

best.explanation: Cantinho da Baia looks like a fun-sized window for Safe fun, Medium confidence: 0.6-0.9 m, 197 kJ, 8 s period, consistent 77/100, and wind is not fully clear.  A forgiving sandy bay with lots of take-off points; this is best for easy wave count and cleaner faces when the north wind is bothering exposed beaches; 6-9s at low tide is basically flat or too weak in the sheltered bay.  Watch: 6-9s at low tide is basically flat or too weak in the sheltered bay.
